description:
Enmascara datos personales y secretos en un texto: correos, teléfonos, tarjetas (Luhn), IBAN, IP, JWT, claves API y claves privadas. Basado en patrones. Cuándo: hay que ocultar datos personales (correos, teléfonos, documentos, tarjetas) en un texto antes de registrarlo o enviarlo a un modelo. No para: extraer direcciones de correo de un texto (extract-emails). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Masks common personal data and secrets in text: emails, phone numbers, Luhn-valid card numbers, IBANs, IPv4 addresses, JWTs, API keys (sk-, AKIA, ghp_, xox, AIza) and PEM private keys. Pattern-based; may miss or over-match. When: personal data (emails, phones, IDs, cards) has to be masked in text before it is logged or sent to a model. Not for: finding email-like addresses in text (extract-emails). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Masks common personal data and secrets in text: emails, phone numbers, Luhn-valid card numbers, IBANs, IPv4 addresses, JWTs, API keys (sk-, AKIA, ghp_, xox, AIza) and PEM private keys. Pattern-based; may miss or over-match. When: personal data (emails, phones, IDs, cards) has to be masked in text before it is logged or sent to a model. Not for: finding email-like addresses in text (extract-emails). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.
